mapper.select: SELECT cd.company_document_id AS companyDocumentId, v.company_document_version_id AS companyDocumentVersionId, cd.category AS category, v.original_file_name AS originalFileName, v.version_no AS versionNo, NULL AS indexStatus FROM company_document_version v JOIN company_document cd ON cd.company_document_id = v.company_document_id WHERE v.company_document_version_id = #{versionId} AND cd.company_id = #{companyId} AND v.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND cd.deleted_at IS NULL
